description: Search memory BEFORE answering to ground responses. Returns grounding scores. Mode 'verify' checks claims against evidence (confidence: verified/partial/weak/unknown). Session-aware: boosts results matching active session goals. Supports temporal filtering. Optional MMR diversification, OOD abstention and an exact tiktoken-based token budget.

abstain_ood.description: Abstain (return empty results with abstain_reason) when the query is out-of-distribution via Mahalanobis distance. Default false.

after.description: ISO8601 datetime — return results created after this time

associative.description: Multi-hop expansion: seeds spreading activation from query-matched entities and pulls in observations on graph-connected entities that no lexical/vector signal surfaced. Additive — never lowers a base hit. Default false.

before.description: ISO8601 datetime — return results created before this time

diversify.description: Post-RRF MMR pass that penalizes near-duplicates among top-K. Default false.

enable_bm25.description: Enable BM25 (ts_rank_cd) as third RRF signal alongside text + vector. Catches queries with rare terms that dense embeddings miss. Default true.

format.description: Response format. compact (DEFAULT): abbreviated keys — e=entity, c=content, t=type, i=importance, s=score. 71% fewer tokens (798 vs 2787 at limit=10, measured). verbose: full key names, only when you need every field.

include_unscoped.description: When a project is active, rows with project_id NULL are hidden. Set true to include that leftover corpus. Default false.

max_tokens.description: Token budget for results (default 5000). Counted exactly via tiktoken cl100k_base.

mmr_lambda.description: MMR balance — 1.0 pure relevance, 0.0 pure diversity. Default 0.7.

mode.description: Search mode (default: hybrid). 'verify' checks if claim is grounded.

ood_threshold.description: Mahalanobis distance threshold for abstention. Defaults to sqrt(chi2_0.99(d)), which scales with the embedding dimension (~21.25 for d=384). Override only if you calibrated on your own corpus.

rerank.description: Cross-encoder rerank top-50 → top-K with bge-reranker-v2-m3. Auto-enabled when CUBA_MODE=completo, or when this build has a real GPU provider active (CUDA/DirectML compiled in AND a working device). Off by default everywhere else, even with the model on disk: on CPU it costs 60-110s and blows the search budget. Explicit true/false always wins; run `memory-industry doctor` to see which reason applies here.

tags.description: Filter observations by tag keyword (exact match against auto-extracted tags)

name: cuba_faro
